ontology.note: The activity class fw:TravelTimeEstimate is declared; a dedicated semantic contract is not yet registered.

evidence.note: Unit tested. The arithmetic is a division and the interesting claim is the assumption, which no recomputation can validate -- whether 70 metres per minute is the right walking speed is a judgement, and whether a straight line stands for a walk is a limitation this widget states rather than tests.

changes.description: Extracted from the retired access widget, which derived proxy minutes inside a nearest-neighbour search. A widget and not a knob on nearest, by the test experiment 107 derived: a minutes column changes every row for every consumer of the distances carrier, so the contract moves. And not a third value of the unit knob either -- metres to kilometres is a pure conversion while minutes is a MODEL, a straight-line distance walked at a constant speed, and putting a model behind a unit selector would present an assumption as a unit. The assumption is named in the receipt on every run. Reads each row unit rather than assuming kilometres, because a metre reading divided by metres-per-minute is right while a kilometre reading is wrong by a thousand. A row with no distance gains no minutes: a missing distance is not a travel time of zero.
